_about: Mamayev Kurgan's tunnel top open to players, as in 0.69d (the owner, 2026-11-16, in level_06/evening_8 with the collision view: "this collision stops players from getting on top of that tunnel", "let's remove it", "in 0.69 I think they did", "so this whole block should be removed of collision"; then, having played it, two more: the green over the rock ledge by the hollow, and the walker collision by the tree on the slope east that keeps players from getting onto the roof from there). Invisible walker-only collision (bullets and the camera never met it) taken out of every level_06 project (day, evening, rain; modes 2, 3, 4, 5, 8): the ring of 15 boxes (editor/walker_collision, cgroup 2, cmask 4) round the roof of the tunnel level/06/object_4 (x 56-87, z 127-145, its top at y 34-38): east over the tunnel's mouth (878, 905, 1047, 1092 of evening_8's collision_objects), south to the hill (846, 868, 910, 861, 869, 935, 1023, 1073, 1044), west (1031, 941); the three boxes by the tree on the slope north-east of the mouth (994, 1004, 1078: x 85.6-93.8, z 141.5-146.5); and from the tunnel's own walker mesh (models/level/06/object_4.model/walker_collision, which every level_06 project places) the 17 triangles of a wall over the rock ledge south of the hollow (x 85.8-88.6, z 134.5-135.2, y 33.4-37 in the map) that neither its drawn model nor its bullet mesh has. The map's outer boundary north of the roof stays (1060, 1052, 946 and the rest). Bot walk grid: the floors newly reached are the roof and the slope's way onto it.
